text:
mai: quick flag from onboarding: Kirin v1.0-q4 failed locale-mix-th v1 smoke. Thai combining marks are getting separated and Hebrew that follows ends up with mirrored ASCII quotes. sacreBLEU ~ -2.9 vs fp32.
oscar: ouch. minimal repro?
mai: used locale-mix-thai_he_mixed case. payload i POSTed:```json
{"src":"สวัสดี: אבג \"test\"","lang":"th-he_mixed"}
```
staging raw output: "สวัส\u000D\u000A: \u200fאבג \uff02test\uff02" (combining mark detached and RLM + fullwidth quotes).
keiko: can you paste tokenizer dumps for q4 vs fp32?
mai: q4 token dump: ```TOKENS: ["สวัส","\u0E47","ดี", ":", "\u200f", "א", "ב", "ג", "\uff02", "test", "\uff02"]``` fp32 token dump: ```TOKENS: ["สวัสดี", ":", "א", "ב", "ג", '"', "test", '"']```
keiko: so the combining sign (U+0E47) became its own token in q4 and triggered later fast-normalize to treat surrounding runs differently. That explains the separated vowel and the bidi sanitizer inserting RLM.
oscar: root cause guess: during QPack vocab shrink we iterate bytes and sometimes split behind 3-byte thai clusters for q4 mapping. If the remap breaks a grapheme cluster, downstream steps see token boundaries incorrectly.
mai: i checked the qpack conversion log: remap step reported a partial codepoint split on line 214 (utf8_iterator yielded two units for U+0E47 in q4 bundle).
keiko: can we hotfix gating: change remap to use a grapheme-aware iterator and add a pre-pack normalization that recombines base+combining into canonical cluster before creating shrink_map.
ci-bot: branch created: fix/krn-q4-thai-grapheme by keiko. CI smoke queued for locale-mix-th v1.
mai: local test after patch: tokens now match fp32 and output string is clean: "สวัสดี: אבג \"test\"". BLEU delta -0.05.
oscar: please add the mixed th+he case to onboarding gate for all quant profiles and add a tiny unit test to catch grapheme splits.
keiko: will add: (1) grapheme-aware remap in qpack, (2) prepack canonicalization step, (3) runtime guard: if token is standalone combining mark then attempt repair before detok.
l10n-bot: queued nightly locale-mix-th v1 run once patch merges.
mai: will update model bring-up checklist with a note about combining marks and qpack assumptions. keep thread open until nightly green.
keiko: thanks everyone. tiny perf hit ~0.4% p50 from extra canonicalization but worth correctness.
ci-bot: CI smoke passed and artifacts attached. nightly run scheduled.
